releaseNotes:
- The update check is no longer silent: the Changelog window now says whether you are on the latest version, whether a newer one is available, or why the check could not run, with a Check again button
- When GitHub limits checks from a busy network (60 an hour per site address), SSM Audit falls back to a second source so the update still shows
- The automatic check quietly retries once if the first attempt runs before the network is ready
